The Powertec Workbench LeverGym® is one of the most functional single-station home gym systems ever created. The heavy-duty isolateral lever arms can safely hold up to 500 lbs combined. The detachable workbench can be removed to perform a multitude of additional exercises.

Features

The Leverage Advantage

Lever arms create the smoothest motion in any weight-training machine — the closest thing to free weights. Built-in safety stops let you train to exhaustion without a spotter; when finished, you simply set the weight down.

Power Lifting Access

The utility bench detaches to access Squat, Calf, Dip, Shrug and Deadlift using the arms, plus Low-row using the lower cable access.

Fully Adjustable Bench Design

Ball-bearing-driven carriage with 9 horizontal and 9 vertical positions, including decline, flat and 7 incline positions.

Shipping & Returns

Free U.S. shipping on most equipment (excludes weights, plates and apparel). Yellow finish may ship on pre-order — see cart for the latest ETA.
